subtitle: Mixed revision: quantifiers and describing people
instructions: Answer all questions. For questions 1 to 9, circle the correct answer. For question 10, write two suitable adjectives. [10 marks]

items.text: ( Many / Much ) visitors came: two hundred.
I have ( a few / a little ) storybooks: five on my shelf.
There is ( much / many ) noise outside.
We need ( some / many ) sugar for the kuih.
He saved ( a lot of / much ) stamps: ninety in his album.
Circle the correct sentence: ( She is a tall girl. / She is a girl tall. )
Circle the correct sentence: ( They are strong players. / They are players strong. )
Circle the correct word: My brother is ( tall and friendly / tallly and friendly ).
Circle the correct words: ( He is / They is ) my best friend.
Complete the sentence: Aiman is ___ANS___ and ___ANS___.

answerMap.10: Any two suitable adjectives (e.g. tall, kind, brave, helpful)
